<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_Dismissal"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal of MSPN"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPN" name="MSPN sends dismissal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_MSPN">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MSPN" name="MSPN">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_MSPN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_Dismissal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_MSPN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Dismissal" name="Send dismissal to MSPO" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_1" sourceRef="Start_MSPN" targetRef="Send_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_2" sourceRef="Send_Dismissal" targetRef="End_MSPN"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPO" name="MSPO reviews dismissal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_MSPO">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MSPO" name="MSPO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Dismissal_Received</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Review_Dismissal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Dismissal_Outcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Reject_Dismissal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Confirm_Dismissal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Dismissal_Received" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Review_Dismissal" name="Review dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Dismissal_Outcome" name="Dismissal outcome"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Reject_Dismissal" name="Reject dismissal of MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Confirm_Dismissal" name="Confirm dismissal of MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Dismissal rejected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_1" sourceRef="Start_Dismissal_Received" targetRef="Review_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_2" sourceRef="Review_Dismissal" targetRef="Gateway_Dismissal_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismissal_Outcome" targetRef="Reject_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismissal_Outcome" targetRef="Confirm_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_3" sourceRef="Reject_Dismissal" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_4" sourceRef="Confirm_Dismissal" targetRef="End_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPN" name="MSPN" processRef="Process_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPO" name="MSPO" processRef="Process_MSPO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Send_Dismissal" targetRef="Start_Dismissal_Received" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
